name: Armada Flea and Farmers Market
description: Armada Flea and Farmers Market is a farmers market in 25381 Armada Ridge Road, MI, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
